methods.name: Quest skip to level 33
methods.note: The Tourist Trap with both rewards on Agility, Recruitment Drive, The Depths of Despair and The Grand Tree give 19,700 XP. Tourist Trap alone reaches 26.

methods.name: Rooftop courses
methods.note: Draynor, Al Kharid, Varrock, Canifis, Falador, Seers, Pollnivneach, Rellekka, then Ardougne at 90. Rates assume no diaries. Marks of grace buy graceful.

methods.name: Brimhaven Arena floor spikes
methods.note: Cross the floor spike trap by the arena entrance back and forth. 200 coins to enter. Bring food, you fail the trap now and then.

methods.name: Agility Pyramid
methods.note: Each pyramid top sells to Simon Templeton for 10,000 coins, about 130,000 an hour early and 260,000 from 70. Fails slow it at low levels.

methods.name: Brimhaven Arena ticket pillars
methods.note: Tag the marked dispenser each minute, use the floor spikes in the downtime and trade tickets for XP. Karamja gloves 2 add 10 percent.

methods.name: Colossal Wyrm course
methods.note: Varlamore course with long obstacles that cannot be failed and very few clicks. Advanced route at 62. Termites buy amylase, bone shards give Prayer XP.

methods.name: Hallowed Sepulchre
methods.note: Floors unlock at 52, 62, 72, 77 and 87. Rates skip every coffin but the Grand Coffin and assume good practice and a private instance. Bring staminas.

methods.name: Wilderness Agility Course
methods.note: Deep Wilderness with player killers, so risk little. Boostable from 47 with summer pies. Tickets give alchables, blighted items and medium clues.

methods.name: Seers' rooftop with Camelot teleport
methods.note: The hard Kandarin Diary moves Camelot Teleport next to the course start, so teleport after every lap. 40,000 to 44,000 an hour without it.

methods.name: Werewolf Agility Course
methods.note: Needs the Ring of Charos. Gives 10 to 15 marks of grace an hour. The death slide stops failing at 80 Agility and Strength with weight under 2kg.

methods.name: Pollnivneach rooftop with hard diary
methods.note: The hard Desert Diary raises the course XP and speeds up marks of grace to 16 to 18 an hour. 47,000 to 51,000 an hour without it.

methods.name: Hallowed Sepulchre looting coffins
methods.note: Loot the worthwhile coffins from floor 3 up for hallowed marks and the ring of endurance. Grand Coffin needs 84 Thieving, or 66 at 92 Agility.

methods.name: Prifddinas Agility Course
methods.note: Rooftop-style course in Prifddinas. Portal shortcuts give about 45 crystal shards an hour instead of marks of grace.

methods.name: Rellekka rooftop with hard diary
methods.note: The hard Fremennik Diary raises the course XP and speeds up marks of grace to 16 to 19.5 an hour. 50,000 to 53,000 an hour without it.

unverified: Quest skip to level 33: one-off quest XP, so no hourly rate (xph 0)
Rooftop courses: bands are midpoints of the no-diary, no-teleport ranges; the guide states no quest requirement for Canifis

Brimhaven Arena floor spikes: 25,500 is 85% of the stated 'up to 30,000'; the page also gives about 36,000 an hour for the single-click version without saying at what level; the Ironman Guide says the arena is not worth it at level 20

Brimhaven Arena ticket pillars: main guide says 45,000-50,000 at level 40 (and 28,000 at 40, 35,000 at 80, up to 67,000 at 99 from tickets alone); Ironman Guide says 50,000-60,000 for levels 40-60; no usable rate by level above 40
Agility Pyramid: 25,000 is stated for levels 30-50 and 44,000 for 70-99; nothing is stated for 50-70

Colossal Wyrm course: main guide says 'up to' 31,000 and 42,000 (85% used); Ironman Guide says 'upwards of' 31,181 and 42,834; the course was lengthened on 12 August 2026 with XP per hour said to stay roughly the same, and the guides still describe the old 60-second lap; neither guide states an access requirement

Hallowed Sepulchre: the Ironman Guide's 'realistic no looting' column differs from the main guide (40,000 / 50,000 / 71,700 / 81,000 / 98,500 against 45,000 / 56,300 / 68,900 / 79,700 / 98,500); the main guide figures are used and assume a private instance

Hallowed Sepulchre looting coffins: Ironman Guide 'realistic looting' column used; the main guide's floor 4-5 looting column gives 75,000 at 77 and 85,800 at 87; the Grand Coffin requirement is quoted from the main guide, while the 12 August 2026 changelog words it as 84 Thieving or 92 Agility
Wilderness Agility Course: level 52 is the entry level; the main guide starts it at 47 with summer pie boosts (49 for the pipe)
Werewolf Agility Course: the page says 67,000-68,000 'at higher levels' without naming a level; the band is placed at 80, where the death slide stops failing
Prifddinas Agility Course: 85% of the main guide's 'up to' 60,000 at 75 and 65,000 from 90; the Ironman Guide says 59,000 and 66,000
